info.name: Cyware Intel Exchange (CTIX) v3 Open Watchlist API

params.name: page
params.description: Pass the page number to retrieve watchlist keywords.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Pass the number of keywords to retrieve on each page.

params.name: last_active_on_from
params.description: Pass the last active from time in epoch format.

params.name: last_active_on_to
params.description: Pass the last active to time in epoch format.

params.name: is_active
params.description: Pass true to retrieve active keywords only. By default, both active and inactive keywords are retrieved.

params.name: created_from
params.description: Pass the created from time in epoch format.

params.name: created_to
params.description: Pass the created to time in epoch format.

params.name: created_by
params.description: Pass the ID of a creator to filter keywords.

items.docs: Returns a list of keywords from the watchlist.

params.description: Pass the ID of the watchlist keyword to update.

items.docs: Updates the details of a keyword in the watchlist.

params.description: Pass the ID of the watchlist keyword to delete.
